lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple high-luminance circular pixel clusters of varying diameters arranged in a semi-random distribution across the mid-lateral flank, partially obscured by surface-induced light refraction.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting with circular blobs to form a non-uniform grid pattern, primarily visible in the region posterior to the pectoral fin.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature along the upper third of the flank exhibiting a sharp luminance gradient transition from high-intensity light on the upper surface to deep shadow on the lower margin.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-contrast distribution of high-luminance circular pixels within the first dorsal fin silhouette, significantly masked by fluctuating surface caustic patterns.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a distinct elongated secondary silhouette (remora) attached near the ventral-lateral junction posterior to the left pectoral fin.
